messages.subject: Re: Problem with the yellow toques
messages.text:
Hi Gabriel,
 

 Is it possible to withhold the tuque until you receive the right color? If not, I'd like to cancel my order. This is not a nice color.
 

 Thanks,
 

 C.

 Le mar. 27 janv. 2026 à 12:48, Lasclay <hey@lasclay.com> a écrit :

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Hi Chloé,

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We want to let you know about an issue with our new batch of yellow beanies that we recently received from a new supplier.

 It is really not the same yellow at all, and we are quite disappointed.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 It’s not ugly, but it is not the same warm, vibrant yellow we were used to, and the one shown on our website at the time of purchase.

 We decided to ship them anyway, since many people had been waiting a long time for their order and this was the only missing item. However, we will absolutely listen to your feedback and any requests regarding this. 

 We look forward to hearing from you once you receive your order.

 Warmly, and we’re sorry for this.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Gabriel 
Co-founder
Lasclay 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lasclay inc.

messages.subject: Re: Problem with the yellow toques
messages.text:
Hello Chloé,
 

 We apologize for the delay in response. By the time we became aware of your message, your order had already been shipped.
 

 We are truly sorry about the situation regarding your order. We completely understand how disappointing it can be to receive a product that does not meet your expectations, and we want to offer our sincerest apologies.
 

 To save you any further inconvenience—like making a return or waiting for a refund—we would like to propose a simple and quick solution:
 ✨ free shipping of a new beanie , in gray or black , all at no cost to you.
 

 This beanie is offered to you, and you may certainly keep it.
 

 We sincerely hope this solution will be suitable for you.
 

 Just let us know your desired color, and we'll take care of the rest.
 

 Looking forward to assisting you.
 

 Warmly,
 

 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
